<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Neil’s Down the Memory Lane</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,600;1,500&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500&family=Caveat:wght@600&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@1,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--gold:#d4af37;--silver:#e6cfc9;--glass:rgba(70,14,32,.62);--text:#f7ebe6;box-sizing:border-box}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;font-family:Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1f060f,#3d0e1f 50%,#5a1830) fixed;min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden}
#stars{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.45}
.moon{display:none;position:fixed;top:7%;right:8%;width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset -18px 6px 0 0 #f4ecd0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(244,236,208,.55));z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
main,#welcome{position:relative;z-index:1}
main{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:30px 16px calc(100px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));text-align:center}
main.hidden{display:none}
#welcome{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;padding:24px;text-align:center;transition:opacity .8s}
#welcome.out{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
h1,h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;margin:0}
h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,9vw,3.6rem);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#fff3c4,var(--silver));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
h2{font-size:1.6rem;color:var(--gold);margin:56px 0 14px}
.eyebrow{letter-spacing:.35em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--silver)}
.card{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.25);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;line-height:1.7;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 0 24px rgba(212,175,55,.08)}
#wmsg{width:min(560px,100%);min-height:150px;text-align:left}
.gap{min-height:70px;margin:26px 0;opacity:.9;font-style:italic;color:var(--silver)}
button{font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:99px;padding:11px 20px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.14);color:var(--gold);cursor:pointer}
button.solid{background:var(--gold);color:#2b0a16;font-weight:500}
.clock{width:min(250px,68vw);margin:28px auto 6px;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(212,175,55,.3))}
#dig{color:var(--silver);font-size:.95rem}
#quote{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.25rem}
#qedit{display:none;width:100%;min-height:220px;margin-top:12px;background:#2b0a16;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font:inherit;font-size:.85rem}
body.edit #qedit{display:block}
.grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:34px}
.pol{width:74%;text-align:left;background:none;padding:0;box-shadow:none}
.pol:nth-child(even){align-self:flex-end}
.pol:nth-child(odd){align-self:flex-start}
.pol img,.ph{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.55);background:linear-gradient(160deg,#5a1830,#8a3a52 70%,#d19a8a)}
.ph{display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.75rem;color:#e8edf5}
.cap{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--silver);margin-top:10px;min-height:1.3em}
[contenteditable=true]{outline:2px dashed var(--gold);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:6px}
.bar{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:5;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 10px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(31,6,15,.95),rgba(31,6,15,0))}
.bar button{background:#2b0a16}
.bar button.solid{background:var(--gold)}
.hide{display:none!important}
#vinylwrap{position:fixed;top:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));right:14px;z-index:7;text-align:center}
#vinyl{background:none;border:0;padding:0;box-shadow:none;cursor:pointer;display:block;border-radius:50%}
.disc{display:block;position:relative;width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:50%;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#0b0b0f 0 2px,#1c1c24 2px 3px),#0b0b0f;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.6),inset 0 0 0 2px #2a2a33;animation:spin 3.2s linear infinite;animation-play-state:paused}
.disc:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 20deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(255,255,255,.22) 12%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 28%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.18) 62%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 78%)}
.disc .label{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:28px;height:28px;margin:-14px 0 0 -14px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#d4af37,#8b1a2b 70%);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:6px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#fff3c4;font-weight:600}
.disc .label:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#1f060f;left:50%;top:50%;margin:-2.5px 0 0 -2.5px}
#vinyl.spin .disc{animation-play-state:running}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#vhint{margin-top:6px;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--silver);text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#review,#locked{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;padding:24px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1f060f,#3d0e1f 50%,#5a1830);overflow-y:auto}
#locked{z-index:50}
#review.on{display:flex;animation:flipin .9s ease both}
#locked.on{display:flex}
@keyframes flipin{from{transform:perspective(900px) rotateY(90deg);opacity:0}to{transform:perspective(900px) rotateY(0);opacity:1}}
.rstep{display:none;width:min(520px,100%)}
.rstep.on{display:block}
.rq{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,7vw,2.4rem);line-height:1.2;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:28px}
.rnote{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--silver);margin-bottom:22px}
.choices{display:flex;gap:18px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.choices.col{flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.choice{padding:16px 26px;font-size:1.05rem;animation:bob 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.choice:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-1.5s}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
#own{width:100%;min-height:90px;margin-top:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font:inherit}
.rstep button,#locked button{margin-top:10px}
body.denied{overflow:hidden}
.flipend{margin:60px 0 20px}
.flipend button{padding:16px 34px;font-size:1.05rem;animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.flow{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:46px;margin:54px 0;text-align:left}
.flow p{margin:0;max-width:80%;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--text)}
.flow p.l{align-self:flex-start}
.flow p.r{align-self:flex-end}
.flow p.big{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-style:normal;font-size:2rem;line-height:1.2}
.flow p.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-style:normal;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--gold);padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.45)}
#letter{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;padding:14vh 24px 24px;text-align:left;transition:opacity .8s}
#letter.out{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper{width:min(520px,100%);background:#f6ece6;color:#3d0e1f;border-radius:6px;padding:34px 28px 40px;box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.paper .tag{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.15rem;color:#7a3a4c}
.paper .to{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,11vw,3.6rem);margin:10px 0 0;color:#5a1830}
.paper .body{margin-top:22px}
.paper .body p{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.28rem;line-height:1.65;margin:0 0 1em;color:#3d0e1f}
.paper .body p.soft{color:#7a3a4c}
.paper .body p.bday{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-style:normal;font-weight:600;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.3;color:#8b1a2b;text-align:center;margin:1.2em 0}
.paper .body p.heads{font-family:Poppins,sans-serif;font-style:normal;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7a3a4c;margin:1.6em 0 .4em}
.paper .signoff{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.2rem;color:#7a3a4c;margin-top:26px}
.paper .signame{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-size:2.2rem;color:#5a1830;margin-top:26px}
#openbtn{margin:22px 0 calc(40px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));padding:14px 34px;font-size:1rem}
.tapnote{margin-top:22px;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--silver);letter-spacing:.05em;animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.cake{width:min(340px,92vw);display:block;margin:20px auto 0;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5))}
.flame{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:flick .45s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s}
@keyframes flick{from{transform:scale(1,1) rotate(-2deg)}to{transform:scale(.92,1.08) rotate(2deg)}}
.glow{transition:opacity .5s;animation:pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes pulse{from{opacity:.55}to{opacity:1}}
.out .flame,.out .glow{opacity:0;animation:none;transform:scale(.2)}
.smoke{opacity:0;fill:none;stroke:#f1e6e0;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round}
.out .smoke{animation:rise 2.4s ease-out}
@keyframes rise{0%{opacity:.8;transform:translateY(0)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-36px)}}
.blowbar{display:block;width:min(360px,100%);margin:18px auto 0;padding:16px;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.08em;border-radius:14px}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity 1s,transform 1s}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.q{margin-top:40px}
.q h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1.9rem;color:var(--text)}
.q .opts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.q .opts button{padding:15px 20px;font-size:1rem}
.q .react{min-height:3em;margin-top:16px;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--gold);transition:opacity .6s}
@keyframes shake{20%,60%{transform:translateX(-8px)}40%,80%{transform:translateX(8px)}}
.shake{animation:shake .45s}
.sign{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-size:2rem;color:var(--gold);margin-top:18px}
.conf{position:fixed;top:-20px;z-index:9;pointer-events:none;animation:fall linear forwards}
@keyframes fall{to{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(600deg)}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stars"></canvas><div class="moon"></div>

<!-- 0. LETTER OPENING (first thing seen). Edit the two lines below: the small tag and the name. -->
<section id="letter">
  <div class="paper">
    <div class="tag">a letter</div>              <!-- EDIT: small line at the top -->
    <div class="to">Hello Batman,</div>                <!-- EDIT: the name it is addressed to -->

    <!-- EDIT: WRITE YOUR LETTER HERE. Each <p>...</p> is one paragraph.
         Copy a whole <p>...</p> line to add more paragraphs. No limit on length. -->
    <div class="body">
      <p>Or should I say Neil Mboma. Yes, I figured out your identity. Did you think you’d stay in the dark forever? I have evidence from childhood to your latest exciting moment, and you’re wondering how. The answer is that I’ve always been your shadow. [evil laugh]</p>
      <p>Okay, scratch that. I know you already think I’m a lunatic, and I’m working on it. But today isn’t about me. It’s about you.</p>
      <p class="bday">HAPPY BIRTHDAY, NEIL!!! 🎂</p>
      <p class="heads">Heads up…</p>
      <p>This link has a few things that might stir up different emotions. I’m hoping for the happy ones. Things got a little rocky lately (you crashed out, my genius, you crashed out), so I sincerely hope this doesn’t make it worse.</p>
      <p class="heads">Official notices:</p>
      <p>The Board of Directors has met, and it unanimously approved this gift. 🎩</p>
      <p>The promise stands. You know the one. Do not test me.</p>
      <p>Disclaimer: this website was built by a student who recently had exams and is still recovering, and a Triple E student to roast (lol jokes). Results may vary. I’m old enough to build you a birthday website, which is more than your circuits can say. ⚡</p>
      <p>If you find something unexpected (which you will), it was never meant to embarrass you or make you uncomfortable. It’s here to celebrate a life well lived by a great person: you. And if at the end of it you feel insecure for any reason, you can take the whole website down forever. That’s entirely your call. Procedure is below.</p>
      <p>Sincere apologies for obtaining personal photos without consent (please don’t sue me).</p>
      <p class="soft">I honestly just wanted to give you this. I hope you enjoy it. I hope you like it.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="signame">— Israella (Твой шпион 🕵🏾‍♀️)</div>         <!-- EDIT: sign-off -->
  </div>
  <button class="solid" id="openbtn">Continue ♡</button>
</section>

<!-- 1. WELCOME SCREEN: edit the message here any time (tap Edit) -->
<section id="welcome" class="hide">
  <div class="eyebrow">A little something for you</div>
  <h1>Neil’s Down the Memory Lane</h1>
  <div id="wmsg" class="card" data-k="welcome">Neil, this is a little trip through the moments that shaped you. Tap Edit to write your own message here.</div>
  <button class="solid" id="enter">Enter</button>
</section>

<main id="main" class="hidden">
  <!-- 2. HEADER: change the date text -->
  <div class="eyebrow">Celebrating</div>
  <h1>Neil’s Down the Memory Lane</h1>
  <div class="card" style="display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;padding:8px 20px" data-k="date">Birthday date here</div>

  <!-- QUESTION: edit the wording any time. Each answer triggers a reaction. -->
  <div class="card q reveal">
    <div class="eyebrow">Neil,</div>
    <h2 data-k="qtitle">Are you ready for your birthday surprise?</h2>
    <div data-k="qsub">I put something together just for you.</div>
    <div class="opts">
      <button class="solid" id="yes" data-k="yes">Yes, let’s go ♡</button>
      <button id="think" data-k="think">Let me think about it</button>
    </div>
    <div class="react" id="react"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- 3. CLOCK -->
  <svg class="clock" viewBox="0 0 200 200" aria-label="Live clock">
    <defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f6d77a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#9c7420"/></linearGradient></defs>
    <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="96" fill="url(#g)"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="88" fill="#2b0a16"/>
    <g id="ticks"></g>
    <line id="h" x1="100" y1="100" x2="100" y2="58" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line id="m" x1="100" y1="100" x2="100" y2="38" stroke="#e8edf5" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line id="s" x1="100" y1="112" x2="100" y2="28" stroke="#c9d1dc" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="5" fill="url(#g)"/>
  </svg>
  <div id="dig"></div>

  <div class="gap" contenteditable="false" data-k="gap1">Space for a message…</div>

  <!-- 4. QUOTE OF THE DAY: picked by day of year. In Edit mode, change the list (one quote per line) -->
  <h2>Quote of the Day</h2>
  <div class="card"><div id="quote"></div>
    <textarea id="qedit" aria-label="Quotes, one per line"></textarea></div>

  <!-- FLOWING WORDS (after Quote of the Day). Each <p> is one short paragraph.
       class="l" = sits on the left, class="r" = sits on the right.
       Add "big" for large heading-style text, or "hand" for gold handwritten text with an underline.
       Copy a whole <p>...</p> line to add more. Alternate l and r so they flow like the video. -->
  <div class="flow">
    <p class="l big">The Engineer’s Special</p>
    <p class="l">Having you as a friend is an added advantage because you’re so eloquent in speech and well articulated. I’m never getting over this fact.</p>
    <p class="r hand">You’re so self restraint, you never let your intrusive thoughts take over, at least that’s from my pov.</p>
    <p class="l">You prioritise your schedule so much that you’d rather let the helpless help themselves than delay by a minute… anyway, I heard it’s discipline.</p>
    <p class="r">You’re soft spoken, which almost makes me believe you’re a man of chivalry… I said almost.</p>
    <p class="l hand">You do what you want but fear the judgement of people who don’t even know you (strangers). I mean, just carry the pink bag already…</p>
    <p class="r" style="max-width:90%">You’re an amazing person, honestly. I love your sense of humour, admire your commitment to things that don’t make sense (school), your self motivation, and how you do too much and too little at the same time. I love how you inspired me to be a manipulator (I’m honoured, master… jokes), love your stickers (not all, but some), and the list goes on…</p>
  </div>

  <div class="gap" data-k="gap2">Space for a message…</div>

  <!-- 5. NOTE -->
  <h2>A Note for Neil</h2>
  <div class="card" data-k="note">Write your heartfelt note to Neil here.</div>

  <div class="gap" data-k="gap3">Space for a message…</div>

  <!-- 6. MEMORIES: put photo1.jpg … photo8.jpg in a folder called photos -->
  <h2>Memories</h2>
  <!-- EDIT: your message under Memories, above the first photo. Replace the text inside the <p>. -->
  <p class="memnote" data-k="memnote" style="font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--silver);margin:0 auto 34px;max-width:88%">Write your message here. It sits right under Memories, above the first photo.</p>
  <!-- EDIT: each block below is one photo. Change the file name in src="photos/photoN.jpg" and the caption text. -->
  <div class="grid" id="grid">
    <div class="pol"><img alt="Memory 1" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="cap" data-k="cap0">once upon a time there was a little boy...</div></div>
    <div class="pol"><img alt="Memory 2" style="object-position:50% 20%" src="data:image/png;base64,"><div class="cap" data-k="cap1">standing tall even then because he knew who he was</div></div>
    <div class="pol"><img alt="Memory 3" style="object-position:50% 15%" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="cap" data-k="cap2">Caption 3</div></div>
    <div class="pol"><img alt="Memory 4" style="aspect-ratio:1;object-position:50% 40%" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="cap" data-k="cap3">Caption 4</div></div>
    <div class="pol"><img alt="Memory 5" style="object-position:50% 25%" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="cap" data-k="cap4">Caption 5</div></div>
    <div class="pol"><img alt="Memory 6" style="object-position:50% 15%" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="cap" data-k="cap5">Caption 6</div></div>
    <div class="pol"><img alt="Memory 7" style="object-position:50% 25%" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="cap" data-k="cap6">Caption 7</div></div>
    <div class="pol"><img alt="Memory 8" style="object-position:50% 25%" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="cap" data-k="cap7">Caption 8</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="gap" data-k="gap4">Space for a message…</div>

  <!-- CAKE: make a wish, then tap the bar to blow out the candles -->
  <h2 data-k="makeH">Make a Wish</h2>
  <div class="card" data-k="makeSub">Fingers crossed, close your eyes and make your wish. Then blow the candles.</div>
  <svg class="cake" id="cake" viewBox="0 0 320 300" aria-label="Red velvet cake with candles 2 and 1">
    <defs>
      <radialGradient id="fl" cx="50%" cy="75%" r="70%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe98a"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#ffb03a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ff5a1a"/></radialGradient>
      <radialGradient id="halo"><stop offset="0" stop-color="rgba(255,196,90,.55)"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="rgba(255,196,90,0)"/></radialGradient>
      <linearGradient id="shade" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity=".55"/><stop offset=".3" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset=".42" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity=".16"/><stop offset=".6" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity=".6"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="sponge" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#a3182f"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#6f0f21"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="cream" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fffaf5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#eadbd0"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="plate" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#8d8a86"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#f4f1ec"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8d8a86"/></linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <ellipse cx="160" cy="292" rx="120" ry="7" fill="#000" opacity=".35"/>
    <path d="M148 268L172 268L176 288L144 288Z" fill="url(#plate)"/>
    <ellipse cx="160" cy="289" rx="48" ry="7" fill="url(#plate)"/>
    <path d="M22 252A138 16 0 0 0 298 252L298 260A138 16 0 0 1 22 260Z" fill="#6f6b66"/>
    <ellipse cx="160" cy="252" rx="138" ry="16" fill="url(#plate)"/>
    <path d="M50 140L50 244A110 18 0 0 0 270 244L270 140Z" fill="url(#sponge)"/>
    <path d="M50 176A110 18 0 0 0 270 176L270 190A110 18 0 0 1 50 190Z" fill="url(#cream)"/>
    <path d="M50 212A110 18 0 0 0 270 212L270 226A110 18 0 0 1 50 226Z" fill="url(#cream)"/>
    <path d="M50 140L50 244A110 18 0 0 0 270 244L270 140Z" fill="url(#shade)"/>
    <g fill="#5a0b19" opacity=".55"><circle cx="90" cy="165" r="1.6"/><circle cx="130" cy="203" r="1.4"/><circle cx="188" cy="168" r="1.5"/><circle cx="236" cy="200" r="1.6"/><circle cx="110" cy="238" r="1.5"/><circle cx="205" cy="240" r="1.5"/></g>
    <ellipse cx="160" cy="140" rx="110" ry="18" fill="url(#cream)"/>
    <ellipse cx="160" cy="140" rx="110" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#d8c6b8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g fill="url(#cream)" stroke="#dccabd" stroke-width="1"><ellipse cx="68" cy="146" rx="11" ry="8"/><ellipse cx="92" cy="154" rx="11" ry="8"/><ellipse cx="118" cy="159" rx="11" ry="8"/><ellipse cx="146" cy="161" rx="11" ry="8"/><ellipse cx="174" cy="161" rx="11" ry="8"/><ellipse cx="202" cy="159" rx="11" ry="8"/><ellipse cx="228" cy="154" rx="11" ry="8"/><ellipse cx="252" cy="146" rx="11" ry="8"/></g>
    <g fill="#b3202f"><path d="M92 148l3 3-3 3-3-3z"/><path d="M146 155l3 3-3 3-3-3z"/><path d="M202 155l3 3-3 3-3-3z"/><path d="M252 142l3 3-3 3-3-3z"/></g>
    <g fill="#d4af37" opacity=".9"><circle cx="120" cy="136" r="1.6"/><circle cx="196" cy="134" r="1.4"/><circle cx="214" cy="143" r="1.5"/><circle cx="104" cy="144" r="1.3"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(124 78)" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><g id="c2"><path d="M0 18C0-2 28-2 28 16C28 30 10 42 0 60L30 60" stroke="#a87f1f" stroke-width="16"/><path d="M0 18C0-2 28-2 28 16C28 30 10 42 0 60L30 60" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="12"/><path d="M-2 18C-2 2 20 0 24 10" stroke="#fff1b8" stroke-width="3" opacity=".8"/></g></g>
    <g transform="translate(164 78)" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 14L18 2L18 60" stroke="#a87f1f" stroke-width="16"/><path d="M6 14L18 2L18 60" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="12"/><path d="M15 6L15 56" stroke="#fff1b8" stroke-width="3" opacity=".8"/></g>
    <path d="M138 70L138 63M182 70L182 63" stroke="#2a1a14" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <g transform="translate(138 63)"><circle class="glow" r="30" cy="-12" fill="url(#halo)"/><g class="flame"><path d="M0-26C10-12 9 0 0 6C-9 0-10-12 0-26Z" fill="url(#fl)"/><path d="M0-10C4-4 4 1 0 4C-4 1-4-4 0-10Z" fill="#fff8d6"/><ellipse cy="3" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#6fa8ff" opacity=".8"/></g><path class="smoke" d="M0-6C-7-16 7-22 0-36"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(182 63)"><circle class="glow" r="30" cy="-12" fill="url(#halo)"/><g class="flame"><path d="M0-26C10-12 9 0 0 6C-9 0-10-12 0-26Z" fill="url(#fl)"/><path d="M0-10C4-4 4 1 0 4C-4 1-4-4 0-10Z" fill="#fff8d6"/><ellipse cy="3" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#6fa8ff" opacity=".8"/></g><path class="smoke" d="M0-6C-7-16 7-22 0-36"/></g>
    <rect x="50" y="140" width="220" height="0" fill="none"/>
  </svg>
  <button class="solid blowbar" id="blow">Click to blow</button>

  <!-- 7. WISHES -->
  <h2>Wishes</h2>
  <div class="card" data-k="wish">May this year be your best yet. Happy Birthday, Neil!</div>

  <div class="sign reveal" data-k="sign">Yours always,</div>
  <div class="gap" data-k="gap5">Space for a message…</div>
<div class="flipend"><button class="solid" id="flipbtn">tap to flip ↻</button></div>
</main>

<div class="bar hide" id="bar">
  <button id="party">🎉 Celebrate</button>
  <button id="edit" class="hide">✎ Edit</button>
  <button id="reset" class="hide">Reset</button>
</div>

<!-- REVIEW PAGE (opens when "tap to flip" is pressed at the end) -->
<div id="review">
  <div class="rstep on" id="s0"><div class="rq">Did you like the website?</div><div class="choices"><button class="solid choice" id="r-yes">Yes</button><button class="choice" id="r-no">No</button></div></div>
  <div class="rstep" id="s-yes"><div class="rq">Would you like to keep it?</div><div class="choices col"><button class="solid choice" id="r-keep">Yes, keep it ♡</button><button class="choice" id="r-deny">I liked it, but I don’t want to revisit it. Deny me access.</button></div></div>
  <div class="rstep" id="s-no"><div class="rq">Would you like me to bring the website down?</div><div class="choices"><button class="solid choice" id="r-down">Yes, bring it down</button><button class="choice" id="r-leave">No, leave it</button></div><textarea id="own" placeholder="Or write your own answer…"></textarea><button class="solid" id="r-send">Send my answer</button></div>
  <div class="rstep" id="s-kept"><div class="rq">Thank you for being here ♡</div><div class="rnote">It will stay right here for you.</div><button class="solid sendans hide">Let Israella know</button><br><button class="rback">Close</button></div>
  <div class="rstep" id="s-sent"><div class="rq">Thank you for your honesty.</div><div class="rnote">Your answer has been noted.</div><button class="solid sendans hide">Let Israella know</button><br><button class="rback">Close</button></div>
</div>
<div id="locked"><div class="rq">This page is now closed.</div><div class="rnote">As you asked, access has been closed. Thank you for visiting.</div><button class="solid sendans hide">Let Israella know</button>
  <div style="margin-top:34px"><input id="ucode" type="password" placeholder="secret word" autocomplete="off" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#f7ebe6;border:1px solid #d4af37;border-radius:99px;padding:11px 18px;font:inherit;text-align:center;width:200px"><br><button id="ubtn" style="margin-top:10px">Unlock</button></div></div>

<audio id="aud" src="music.mp3" loop preload="none"></audio>

<!-- VINYL: tap the record to start the song. Put your song next to index.html and name it music.mp3 -->
<div id="vinylwrap" class="hide">
  <button id="vinyl" aria-label="Play or pause music"><span class="disc"><span class="label">NEIL</span></span></button>
  <div id="vhint">tap to play</div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i)};
  function get(k){try{return localStorage.getItem('neil_'+k)}catch(e){return null}}
  function put(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem('neil_'+k,v)}catch(e){}}

  // ---- Stars + shooting star ----
  var cv=$('stars'),cx=cv.getContext('2d'),stars=[],shoot=null;
  function size(){cv.width=innerWidth;cv.height=innerHeight;stars=[];for(var i=0;i<130;i++)stars.push({x:Math.random()*cv.width,y:Math.random()*cv.height,r:Math.random()*1.4+.3,p:Math.random()*6})}
  addEventListener('resize',size);size();
  setInterval(function(){if(!shoot&&Math.random()<.35)shoot={x:Math.random()*cv.width*.7+50,y:Math.random()*cv.height*.3,l:0}},4000);
  (function draw(t){cx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
    stars.forEach(function(s){cx.globalAlpha=.4+.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(t/1200+s.p));cx.fillStyle='#fff';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,7);cx.fill()});
    if(shoot){shoot.l+=14;var e=shoot.l,x=shoot.x+e,y=shoot.y+e*.55;cx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,1-e/260);cx.strokeStyle='#fff';cx.lineWidth=1.6;cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(x,y);cx.lineTo(x-70,y-38);cx.stroke();if(e>260)shoot=null}
    requestAnimationFrame(draw)})(0);

  // ---- Letter -> Welcome ----
  $('openbtn').onclick=function(){var l=$('letter');l.classList.add('out');setTimeout(function(){l.classList.add('hide');$('welcome').classList.remove('hide');scrollTo(0,0)},700)};

  // ---- Welcome -> Enter ----
  $('enter').onclick=function(){$('welcome').classList.add('out');setTimeout(function(){$('welcome').classList.add('hide');$('main').classList.remove('hidden');$('bar').classList.remove('hide');$('vinylwrap').classList.remove('hide');scrollTo(0,0)},700)};

  // ---- Clock ----
  var s='';for(var i=0;i<60;i++){var a=i*6*Math.PI/180,b=i%5==0,r1=b?74:80;s+='<line x1="'+(100+r1*Math.sin(a))+'" y1="'+(100-r1*Math.cos(a))+'" x2="'+(100+84*Math.sin(a))+'" y2="'+(100-84*Math.cos(a))+'" stroke="'+(b?'#d4af37':'#c9d1dc')+'" stroke-width="'+(b?2.5:.8)+'"/>'}
  $('ticks').innerHTML=s;
  function rot(id,d){$(id).setAttribute('transform','rotate('+d+' 100 100)')}
  (function tick(){var d=new Date(),sec=d.getSeconds()+d.getMilliseconds()/1000,m=d.getMinutes()+sec/60,h=d.getHours()%12+m/60;rot('s',sec*6);rot('m',m*6);rot('h',h*30);
    $('dig').textContent=d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'})+' · '+d.toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});requestAnimationFrame(tick)})();

  // ---- Quotes (60+). Edit here or in Edit mode. ----
  var DEFAULTS=["Every day is a new page; write it well.","Good friends are the quiet wealth of a life.","Courage is doing it anyway.","Time is the one gift that never returns.","Be the calm in the storm.","Strong roots allow tall branches.","Make today the story you tell later.","Discipline is a form of self respect.","The best is built slowly.","Gratitude turns enough into plenty.","Stay humble, work hard, be kind.","A steady mind wins the long game.","Your past is a map, not a cage.","Small habits shape great men.","Laughter is the shortest distance between two people.","Do what is right, not what is easy.","The night is darkest before the stars show.","Make memories worth remembering.","Be loyal to the people who stood by you.","Progress beats perfection.","Walk your own road with pride.","Wisdom grows where patience lives.","Fortune favors the prepared.","Leave every place better than you found it.","Real strength is gentle.","Choose the harder right over the easier wrong.","Every ending is a quiet beginning.","Family is where the story starts.","Aim high, stay grounded.","The man you become is built by what you repeat.","Keep your word like gold.","Be present; the moment is the gift.","Fear is only a door to growth.","Work in silence, let success speak.","Honor is made in private.","A good laugh heals many wounds.","Dream big, begin now.","Age is only a number; character is the sum.","Never stop learning.","Cherish the people, not the things.","Where there is a will, there is a road.","Calm is a superpower.","Be grateful for the climb, not just the view.","Lead by example.","Success is peace of mind first.","Make room for joy.","Turn setbacks into setups.","The stars are for those who look up.","Live with purpose, love with heart.","Your story is still being written.","Respect is earned in drops, lost in buckets.","Trust the process, trust yourself.","Another year wiser, another year stronger.","Strength grows in the moments you think you can’t.","Be the reason someone smiles today.","Love generously, forgive freely.","Great things take time and heart.","Be proud of how far you have come.","Here’s to many more adventures.","Cheers to the man, the legend, the friend."];
  function quotes(){var v=get('quotes');return (v?v.split('\n'):DEFAULTS).map(function(x){return x.trim()}).filter(Boolean)}
  function showQuote(){var q=quotes(),d=new Date(),doy=Math.floor((d-new Date(d.getFullYear(),0,0))/864e5);$('quote').textContent='“'+(q[doy%q.length]||'')+'”'}
  $('qedit').value=quotes().join('\n');showQuote();
  $('qedit').oninput=function(){put('quotes',this.value);showQuote()};

  // ---- Memories grid: photos/photo1.jpg … photo8.jpg ----
  document.querySelectorAll('.pol img').forEach(function(im){im.onerror=function(){var p=document.createElement('div');p.className='ph';p.textContent='Add photo';this.replaceWith(p)}});

  // ---- Edit mode (saved in localStorage) ----
  var els=document.querySelectorAll('[data-k]');
  els.forEach(function(el){var v=get(el.dataset.k);if(v)el.textContent=v;el.addEventListener('input',function(){put(el.dataset.k,el.textContent)})});
  $('edit').onclick=function(){var on=document.body.classList.toggle('edit');els.forEach(function(el){el.contentEditable=on});$('edit').textContent=on?'✓ Done':'✎ Edit';$('reset').classList.toggle('hide',!on);$('edit').classList.toggle('solid',on)};
  $('reset').onclick=function(){if(confirm('Reset all edits on this device?')){try{Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(function(k){if(k.indexOf('neil_')==0)localStorage.removeItem(k)})}catch(e){}location.reload()}};

  // ---- Music (starts only after a tap) ----
  var a=$('aud'),vn=$('vinyl'),vh=$('vhint');
  function vstate(on){vn.classList.toggle('spin',on);vh.textContent=on?'playing…':'tap to play'}
  vn.onclick=function(){
    if(a.paused){var r=a.play();if(r&&r.catch)r.catch(function(){vstate(false);vh.textContent='add music.mp3'})}
    else{a.pause()}};
  a.addEventListener('play',function(){vstate(true)});
  a.addEventListener('pause',function(){vstate(false)});
  a.addEventListener('error',function(){vstate(false);vh.textContent='add music.mp3'});

  // ---- Question reactions ----
  var R=$('react'),n=0,tl=['Take your time… the stars will wait ✨','Still thinking? I’ll be right here.','Okay okay… I know you want to say yes 😄','Last chance… the surprise is worth it ♡'];
  $('yes').onclick=function(){R.textContent='Then let’s go down memory lane… 🌙';$('party').click();setTimeout(function(){var t=document.querySelector('.clock');if(t)t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'})},1800)};
  $('think').onclick=function(){R.textContent=tl[n%tl.length];n++;this.classList.remove('shake');void this.offsetWidth;this.classList.add('shake');var y=$('yes');y.style.transform='scale('+Math.min(1.25,1+n*.06)+')'};

  // ---- Fade-in on scroll ----
  document.querySelectorAll('main .card,main h2,.pol,.flow p').forEach(function(e){e.classList.add('reveal')});
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.15});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(e){io.observe(e)});

  // ---- Cake: blow out / relight ----
  var lit=true;
  $('blow').onclick=function(){var c=$('cake');
    if(lit){c.classList.add('out');this.textContent='Happy 21st Birthday, Neil! ♡ (tap to relight)';$('party').click();lit=false}
    else{c.classList.remove('out');this.textContent='Click to blow';lit=true}};

  // ---- Review page: flip, answers, deny access ----
  // EDIT: put Israella's WhatsApp number (digits only, with country code, e.g. 2637...) or an email below so answers can be sent to her.
  var REPLY_WHATSAPP='260770800255', REPLY_EMAIL='', answer='';
  var rv=$('review'),lk=$('locked');
  function step(id){document.querySelectorAll('.rstep').forEach(function(e){e.classList.remove('on')});$(id).classList.add('on')}
  function lock(){document.body.classList.add('denied');lk.classList.add('on');try{a.pause()}catch(e){}}
  try{if(location.hash==='#unlock')localStorage.removeItem('neil_denied');else if(localStorage.getItem('neil_denied')==='1')lock()}catch(e){}
  if(REPLY_WHATSAPP||REPLY_EMAIL)document.querySelectorAll('.sendans').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('hide')});
  function notify(){var m='Neil\u2019s review: '+answer;if(REPLY_WHATSAPP)window.open('https://wa.me/'+REPLY_WHATSAPP+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(m),'_blank');else if(REPLY_EMAIL)location.href='mailto:'+REPLY_EMAIL+'?subject='+encodeURIComponent('Website review')+'&body='+encodeURIComponent(m)}
  document.querySelectorAll('.sendans').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=notify});
  document.querySelectorAll('.rback').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){rv.classList.remove('on')}});
  $('flipbtn').onclick=function(){rv.classList.add('on');step('s0')};
  $('r-yes').onclick=function(){step('s-yes')};
  $('r-no').onclick=function(){step('s-no')};
  $('r-keep').onclick=function(){answer='Liked the website and wants to keep it.';step('s-kept')};
  $('r-deny').onclick=function(){answer='Liked the website but does not want to revisit it. Access has been closed on this device.';try{localStorage.setItem('neil_denied','1')}catch(e){}rv.classList.remove('on');lock()};
  $('r-down').onclick=function(){answer='Did not like the website. Please bring it down.';step('s-sent')};
  $('r-leave').onclick=function(){answer='Did not like the website, but there is no need to bring it down.';step('s-sent')};
  $('r-send').onclick=function(){var t=$('own').value.trim();if(!t){$('own').focus();return}answer='Did not like the website. His own answer: '+t;step('s-sent')};

  $('ubtn').onclick=function(){var v=$('ucode').value.trim().toLowerCase();if(v==='neisra'){try{localStorage.removeItem('neil_denied')}catch(e){}location.href=location.href.split('#')[0]}else{$('ucode').value='';$('ucode').placeholder='try again'}};

  // ---- Admin: Edit is hidden until the secret code is entered ----
  // Tap the page title 5 times quickly, then type the code. EDIT the code below to change it.
  var ADMIN_CODE='neisra',taps=0,tt;
  function showEdit(){$('edit').classList.remove('hide')}
  try{if(sessionStorage.getItem('neil_admin')==='1')showEdit()}catch(e){}
  document.querySelectorAll('h1').forEach(function(h){h.addEventListener('click',function(){
    taps++;clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(function(){taps=0},2500);
    if(taps>=5){taps=0;var c=window.prompt('Admin code');
      if(c&&c.trim().toLowerCase()===ADMIN_CODE){try{sessionStorage.setItem('neil_admin','1')}catch(e){}showEdit()}}})});

  // ---- Confetti ----
  $('party').onclick=function(){var cols=['#d4af37','#f6e3a1','#c9d1dc','#ffffff'];for(var i=0;i<70;i++){var p=document.createElement('div');p.className='conf';p.style.cssText='left:'+Math.random()*100+'vw;width:'+(5+Math.random()*6)+'px;height:'+(9+Math.random()*8)+'px;background:'+cols[i%4]+';animation-duration:'+(2.5+Math.random()*2.5)+'s;animation-delay:'+Math.random()*.8+'s';document.body.appendChild(p);setTimeout(function(n){n.remove()},6500,p)}};
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
